$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this repo's project-scoped agent hooks. Hand-edit ONLY this file, then run `mise run hooks:sync` (or re-cd into the repo) to regenerate every per-agent config. Generated files are NOT hand-edited. Pattern: the /ssot-fanout skill. See .agents/hooks/README.md.

hooks.description: Inject a project-skills + BMAD-recap reminder into each prompt.
Recall Hindsight memories for the prompt (no-ops gracefully if the hindsight CLI is absent).
Retain file edits into Hindsight after Write/Edit/MultiEdit.
Capture a session summary + write a Hindsight journal entry on stop.

claude.notes: Project hooks remain portable fallbacks. Fanout owns only its canonical command paths and preserves foreign groups. Activated Bloodbank hub concerns are omitted automatically.

codex.notes: Native timeouts are seconds. Fanout replaces only this project hook path and suppresses concerns already owned by the activated hub. SessionEnd is true closure; Stop completes a turn.

hermes.notes: Standalone project fallback adapter. on_session_finalize is true session closure; on_session_end is a turn. The active central hub owns fleet hooks and suppresses this fallback.

kimi.notes: Kimi uses ~/.kimi-code/config.toml (or KIMI_CODE_HOME). Native timeouts are seconds. Sentinel-owned fallback hooks are suppressed automatically when the hub owns each concern.
